THE SCENE

You are on a class trip to a beach. A First Nation is building a clam garden here again. Your team must finish the last picture of your comic before the bus leaves. It needs four numbers, and four people each have one.

THE HISTORY

Your comic is about clam gardens. First Nations on the Pacific coast built them for thousands of years. They built a low rock wall at the edge of the sea. Sand stayed behind the wall, so more clams grew.
